note: Provider adapters in providers/*.mjs. Credentials are environment variable NAMES only; values never live in the repo. Entries with adapter: true must match the adapters registered in providers/index.mjs (checked by `cstack validate` and tests). Model ids and prices live in registry/models.json, not here.

conventions.kind: media = image/video generation or edit through the media runner; research = reference search, extraction, verification; local = runs on this machine, costs nothing
conventions.status: live = implemented adapter that calls a real API when its env vars are set; stub = documented placeholder that throws until implemented; mock = deterministic test double, never calls out
conventions.operations: what the adapter or tool does, in cstack terms; the media runner's `operation` field is free text recorded in the ledger and sidecars

providers.name: Mock provider
providers.notes: Deterministic T1 double: FAIL_POLICY in the prompt raises a policy failure, SLOW:n polls n times before done.

providers.name: fal
providers.notes: Queue API (submit, status, result). Model ids come from registry/models.json; costs are reconciled from billing, never inferred.

providers.name: Taste Labs
providers.notes: Search and verifier were alpha on 2026-09-14; shapes may change. Research notes: docs/research/taste-labs.md.

providers.name: Higgsfield
providers.notes: Documented stub: route by mode (image, video, product photoshoot, brand kit) once implemented.

providers.name: OpenAI image
providers.notes: Documented stub; many teams reach these models through fal instead.

providers.name: Local verifier
providers.notes: Deterministic value gates plus an independent judge, run by /brand-verify; score stays null unless a rubric defines one.

providers.name: Local region paste
providers.cli: cstack edit paste --base a.png --patch b.png --x N --y N [--feather 8] [--region x,y,w,h] --out c.png
providers.notes: Not a media-runner adapter. Pure Node for PNG; JPEG/WebP use Chromium through the optional playwright-core and fail with MISSING when it is absent.
